newsitem.title: CHINA: China police seize 74 mln yuan in forged notes.
newsitem.headline: China police seize 74 mln yuan in forged notes.

text.p: Police in the southern Chinese province of Guangdong have seized 74 million yuan ($8.9 million) in forged notes in communist China's largest-ever haul of counterfeit cash, the China News Service said on Friday.

Police in Shantou city had arrested four Taiwanese suspects after discovering 37 bags stuffed with fake 100-yuan notes in a secret compartment in the bottom of a Taiwan fishing boat on July 11, the agency said.
A tip-off on July 9 had warned police of a large shipment of fake cash coming from Taiwan by sea, it said without elaborating.
The Shantou branch of the People's Bank of China had said the forged notes were printed with 1990 dates, it said.
The case was the biggest seizure of counterfeit money since the founding of the communist-ruled People's Republic of China in 1949, it said.
Guangdong police had cracked 500 counterfeiting cases since the second half of 1994, arresting more than 600 suspects and seizing more than 210 million yuan in fake notes, it said.
